statement: A three-valued admission/evidence fact (`true | false | undefined`, where `undefined` means 'could not be determined') MUST NEVER be read with a coarse boolean negation (`if (!value)`) to decide a refusal. `!undefined === true` in JavaScript, so a plain negation silently renders every unresolved audit gap as a hard negative. Any new call site that consumes a three-valued observer (`resolveAgentAdmissionState`, `resolveAgentRegistrationState`, and any future observer following the same house pattern) MUST branch on `=== undefined` (an audit gap: propagate as "unresolved", never as a refusal) and `=== false` (a real negative: refuse) as two explicit, distinct branches.
classification: Generalizes an already-repeated pattern this codebase has fixed multiple times at the OBSERVER layer (agentAdmissionState.ts's own header documents the sponsorship/Passport/registration cases) — this occurrence shows the same defect class recurring at a NEW CONSUMER call site that read the observer's three-valued contract carelessly, proving the pattern needs to be guarded at every consumption point, not just documented once at the source.

canaries.assertion: evaluateFinancialServiceEligibility() resolves ADMISSION_UNRESOLVED (never NOT_ADMITTED) when resolveAgentAdmissionState returns delegationActive: undefined, and resolves NOT_ADMITTED only when it returns delegationActive: false — the two are asserted as distinct outcomes, not merged.

occurrences.defect: `if (!admission.delegationActive)` collapsed `delegationActive: undefined` (an audit gap — e.g. a migrated agent whose RootDID self-heal never ran because callerAuthProfileId was never threaded through) into the same NOT_ADMITTED refusal as a real `delegationActive: false`, making every agent read as universally not-admitted on first live use.

The 2026-08-23 repair pass generalized the SAME discipline to two more branch points introduced by that pass's own composition: `personaScopedDelegationActive` (undefined when the agent's own root-identity read failed vs. false when it genuinely has none) and `FinancialServicesVerificationState` (undefined on a receipt-read failure vs. false when Pulse/P&L are genuinely incomplete) — each guarded with the same explicit undefined/false branching this candidate requires, proving the discipline needed to be re-applied deliberately at each new composition point rather than inherited automatically from the first fix.

notes: This is the SAME defect shape `services/journey/agentAdmissionState.ts`'s own header documents at length for its own three canonical sources (sponsorship/Passport/delegation) — 'A caller must not render "not sponsored" for "could not tell"'. That file got it right internally; the defect was a NEW consumer (this session's own eligibility.ts) that called it without preserving the same discipline. The general lesson: documenting a three-valued discipline at the producer does not, by itself, protect a future consumer — each new call site needs its own explicit undefined/false branch, and ideally a canary at that call site (as added here), not just trust that the author read the producer's comments.

A worthwhile future structural refinement (not built here, per the same session's 'no new primitives absent a proven gap' freeze ruling): a shared, typed helper (e.g. `resolveTristateRefusal(value, unresolvedCode, falseCode)`) that makes the undefined/false branch impossible to collapse by construction, rather than relying on every call site remembering to write both branches by hand. Flagged as a candidate architectural refinement per the Prospective Evolution Capture rule, not authorized to build without explicit operator sign-off.
